text: This report summarizes the changes impacting the City of Toronto (the City)'s obligatory reserve funds (deferred revenues), reserves, and Council-directed reserve funds as at June 30, 2020. The City's deferred revenues (obligatory reserve funds), reserves, and Council-directed reserve funds are subject to annual changes based on funding contributions, transfers, and drawdowns, which are authorized by legislation, third-party agreements, and Council's approvals. The tables and appendices reflect information by major category. As at June 30, 2020, the City recognized $6,837.1 million of deferred revenues (obligatory reserve funds), reserves, and Council-directed reserve funds, which consist of the following balances: - Committed funds for legislated, contractually bound or Council-directed activities ($5,800.1 million); - Committed funds to offset capital costs and pressures on rate-based…
